title: Sample Platform

questions.question: What is the goal?
questions.answer: Ship the sample platform in three phases.

conflicts: SRC-01 vs SRC-02: the brief says two phases, the notes say three

decisions.title: Three phases
decisions.why: The notes are newer than the brief.

assumptions.text: The sample platform has one owner.

requirements.text: The platform exposes a health endpoint.
The platform publishes a status page.
The platform integrates with an external billing account.
The platform ships a mobile client.

deliverables.title: Core service
deliverables.why: Everything else builds on the service.

acceptance.text: The service starts from a clean checkout.

deliverables.dod: Acceptance criteria pass and G1 is green.
risks: Scope creep -> keep the skeleton minimal

deliverables.title: Storage layer

acceptance.text: A written record is read back after a restart.

deliverables.dod: Acceptance criteria pass and G1 is green.

deliverables.title: Status page
deliverables.why: Operators need a public view of service health.

acceptance.text: The page renders the health state.
The page is readable on a phone.

verify.evidence: owner checks the page on a phone

deliverables.title: Release bundle

acceptance.text: The bundle contains the service and the page.
The bundle installs on a clean machine.

verify.evidence: install the bundle in a scratch directory

deliverables.dod: Acceptance criteria pass and G1 and G2 are green.
risks: Missing file in the bundle -> list files in the test

deliverables.title: Billing hookup
deliverables.why: Billing needs an account that only the owner can open.

acceptance.text: The billing account is connected to the platform.

risks: Account never opens -> keep the card Could

objective.text: Ship the sample platform with storage, a status page and billing.
objective.acceptance: All Must deliverables are integrated and G1 and G2 are green.
objective.done: The owner has used the platform end to end.

thesis: Build the service first, then the features in parallel, then billing.
crossRisks: The owner is the only reviewer -> keep tasks small
